race.comment: PRESTIGE GEOFFREY (2) is the clear starting point after a BM56 fourth at Yarra Valley where he was held up until passing the 200m and never had the chance to build proper momentum. He was near the top of an open market there, has placed at this distance and gets Jake Duffy, the top-ranked jockey for wins at this track, so the profile reads strongly. GIVE SOME LIP (3) was plain when tenth in a BM56 at this track last start, but he is third-up, on a quick back-up and drops into a more suitable race after earlier making ground from well back as favourite at Kilmore. The first try around 2000m is the qualification. MORAL TURPITUDE (4) also has a genuine excuse after being held up near the 300m in a Class 1 at Wagga and his previous Wodonga run was sound enough for this grade. CAPTAIN BARBOSSA (1) has the apprentice claim and wet-track record to be competitive, though his record around 2000m keeps him more in the placing mix than a confident winning push.
